content:
**Scattershot** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Applies portion of a dealt limb damage to all of the enemy limbs.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | 20% of the damage dealt to a limb is applied to all limbs on your target. | 00322359 | 

Before update 60, the perk worked only with shotguns. It increased their reload speed by 10%/20%/30% and reduced their weight by 30%/60%/90%.
